data: raw/ CSV drive files (sha256-verified originals), drive_master.csv (columns file, date, drive_type, ev_rpm_dt_med_s), seasonal_drive_master.csv (thermal_regime); NOT tools/, tests/, analyses/M446_*
method_refs: analyses/M441_spec.md Rev 2.1-2.2 (interval extractor, ratio of sums, assumed masses, plateau rule, support floors, day-clustered bootstrap B=4000 seed 42 percentile)
analyses/M444_spec.md Rev 2.1-2.3 sections 1-4 (reference mix, common support, standardization, S14 own-day sets, S15)

definitions.strata: fast = drive master ev_rpm_dt_med_s < 1.0; slow = >= 1.0; undefined = neither; cohort all
definitions.b_nat: fast: f in {2,3}: decimate EVERY channel (speed, rpm, I, V, SoC, temperature) keeping every f-th native sample from index q, q=0..f-1; the decimated v2 table is the equal-weight stack (pooled mean over phases) of the f phase variants; b_nat = max over f of |cell value native - cell value decimated|, point values, same drives and days, all intervals. slow: f=2 only, common-support variant: only intervals whose mid-point lies inside a kept (non-trimmed) interval of the other run, per phase, mean of the two phase differences
definitions.cellValue: temperature bin, All SOC, observed apparent KE recovery pct = 100 sum(charge)/sum(KE) over the cell's kept intervals
definitions.phases: slow b_nat per phase q: difference of the cell value native minus decimated (d2 phase q, every 2nd native sample of every channel from index q) on the common-support intervals; phaseDiffs lists the two signed phase differences; bNat = |mean of the two|; bNatMaxPhase = max |phase difference|
definitions.steps: step = value(b) - value(a) for adjacent SUPPORTED temperature cells; day-clustered interval of the step from the same resamples (default_rng(42), integers(0,D,(B,D)), B=4000); label resolved iff the interval excludes 0 and |step| > bNat(a)+bNat(b)

return: JSON <2 KB: per claim AGREE/DISAGREE with your value and the difference (pp); say what you could not reproduce and why. Tolerance 0.01 pp for point values, 0.05 pp for interval limits.
forbidden: do not read tools/, tests/, analyses/M446_*, summary_arrays.json key regenDisplayV2, CHANGELOG.md
